name: Land Title Building
description: Look up at this ornate brick, sandstone and cast-iron building: it carries the first known stone carving in Fort Worth, the figure of an owl.

name: Pioneer's Rest Cemetery
description: This burial ground began in the summer of 1850 with the deaths of Sophie and Willis Arnold, the young children of Major Ripley Arnold, commander of the fort that gave Fort Worth its name.

name: Cowtown Coliseum
description: A marker here honors Bill Pickett, the Black cowboy who originated bulldogging, the rodeo event now called steer wrestling.

name: Douglass and McGar Parks
description: During Jim Crow segregation, from the late 1800s through the 1920s, Douglass and McGar Parks here were the recreation grounds for Fort Worth's African Americans.
